BiblicalUsage: Jerijah is an Israelite, a Levite chief of Hebron. In 1 Chronicles 23:19, Jeriah the first, Amariah the second. The fuller story is told on the Jerijah, Chief of Hebron profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jerijah matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
